about_fast.bands: The band comes from debt payments as a share of net monthly income (DSR). Green is below 30%, Yellow is 30% to below 60%, Red is 60% or more. Once Red, FAST keeps showing Red until DSR drops below 55%. A worse band shows at once; a better band shows only after it has held for 2 months in a row.
about_fast.no_band: No band is shown while typical monthly income over the last 3 months is below RM300.
about_fast.total_debt: Total debt compared with yearly income (DTI) is shown for information; it does not set the band.
about_fast.cushion: The cushion is how many months of essential costs and debt payments your cash would cover. The first goal is 1 month, the next is 3 months.
about_fast.health_score: The health score, out of 100, averages up to 4 parts. 80 or more is Healthy, 40 to below 80 is Coping, below 40 is Vulnerable.
about_fast.forecast: The forecast is the chance that, in the next 3 months, the band gets worse or money runs short. It comes from a model trained on made-up (synthetic) data, so it is an estimate, not a certainty.
about_fast.help: AKPK (Agensi Kaunseling dan Pengurusan Kredit, set up by Bank Negara Malaysia) gives free debt counselling. For scams, call the National Scam Response Centre at 997.
about_fast.points: FAST's points and garden reward honest records and a growing cushion, never spending. Hiding income or skipping records does not help.
